{"metadata":{"description":"MCP Tools panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: every MCP server & tool in your session, grouped by server, with JSON schemas, live search and last-used times from real session logs.","id":"gh:1337045951","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-mcp-view","slug":"stopchewing/dsh-mcp-view","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","mcp","mcp-server","mcp-tools","plugin","tool-registry","web-ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"MCP Tools panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: every MCP server & tool in your session, grouped b"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"y server, with JSON schemas, live search and last-used times from real session logs."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🔌 dsh-mcp-view"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"### See every MCP server & tool in your DeepSeek Harness session — right in the Web GUI."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**English** · 中文 · Русский"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"*A floating MCP inventory panel for the DSH sidebar: servers grouped, tools with JSON schemas, live "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"search, and **last-used times pulled from real session logs** — nothing invented.*"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"DSH runs your MCP servers (docs, build & analytics — whatever you have configured) and registers the"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ir tools into the shared `mcp__*` namespace — but there was **no UI to see them**. This plugin adds "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"a one-click panel that answers: *what MCP servers are configured, which tools are registered, what t"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"heir input schemas look like, and when each was last used.*"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| 🖥 **All servers, one panel** | Every `dsh-mcp-client` instance in your profile, with transport (`s"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"tdio` / `streamable-http`) and endpoint (command or URL), plus connection state (active / disabled /"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" no tools). |
| 🗂 **Collapsed by default** | Servers are folded into a single compact row; one click"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" expands the tool list. `+` / `−` in the header expands or collapses everything. |
| 🧬 **Full JSON s"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"chemas** | Each tool shows its raw name, description and the exact `inputSchema` the model sees — ex"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"pandable, prettified. |
| 🕘 **Last-used times & usage** | Derived from real `tool/call` events in `~"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"/.dsh/sessions/**/session.jsonl[.zstd]` — per tool *and* per server, plus a **Usage** tab with total"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" calls, a calls-per-day chart and the most-used tools. |
| 🔍 **Live search** | Filter by tool name, "},{"id":"p8s9","text":"raw name, description, server **or parameter names**; auto-refresh every 10 s plus a manual refresh "},{"id":"p8s10","text":"button. |
| 🎯 **Per-session view** | Toggle to see only the tools the current session's agent really"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" sees (resolved from the session's agent scope). |
| ❤️ **Favorites & sorting** | Star servers/tools"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"; sort by name / tools / last-used / favorites. State persists in `localStorage`. |
| ⚕️ **Health ch"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"ecks** | One-click probe of streamable-http endpoints (HEAD) → up/down badge per server. |
| 📤 **Exp"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ort** | Download the whole inventory as JSON or Markdown. |
| 🧩 **Non-MCP context** | A collapsible "},{"id":"p8s15","text":"list of the other (built-in / plugin) globally-registered tools, so you can see the whole tool lands"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"built-in / plugin) globally-registered tools, so you can see the whole tool landscape at a glance. |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## ⚙️ Configuration"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The plugin accepts an optional `config` object on its row in `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 📸 Screenshots"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| | Light | Dark |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| **Servers** |  |  |
| **Usage** |  |  |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## ⚡ Quick start"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then **restart `dsh web`** and refresh the page — a **「MCP Tools」** button appears at the bottom of "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rt `dsh web`** and refresh the page — a **「MCP Tools」** button appears at the bottom of the sidebar."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## 📦 Install"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### From npm"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### From the repository"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Manual (no CLI)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. Put this package into the profile's `node_modules` (copy, or a junction on Windows):"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"2. Append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"3. Restart `dsh web`, then **F5** the page."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"> The profile patch is watched, so the host half activates live; the client bundle is served fresh a"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"t `/plugins/dsh-mcp-view/client.js` — a page refresh is all the browser needs."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## 🎛 Usage"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"1. Click **「MCP Tools」** in the sidebar footer (icon-only when the sidebar is collapsed).
2. Browse "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"servers — each row shows transport, tool count and last use; click to expand tools.
3. Click a tool "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"to see its description, full public name and JSON input schema.
4. Type in the filter box to narrow "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"tools and servers; `Esc` or ✕ closes the panel."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## 🗺 Architecture"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Half | File | Role |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| **Host** | `lib/index.js` | `GET /api/mcp-view/tools` returns the JSON inventory: MCP instances fr"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"om the Cordis loader, live tool schemas from `ctx.tools`, and last-use history scanned from session "},{"id":"p34s3","text":"logs (incremental scan memoized by file mtime/size, 15 s TTL). |
| **Browser** | `lib/client.js` | C"},{"id":"p34s4","text":"lient plugin bundle: registers the sidebar toggle in the `sidebar.footer.action` slot and the floati"},{"id":"p34s5","text":"ng panel in the `shell.overlay` slot. |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"No changes to dsh sources — it is a hot-pluggable profile plugin, same mechanism as the `@linxin666`"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"sh sources — it is a hot-pluggable profile plugin, same mechanism as the `@linxin666` web-ui family."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## 🔒 Security & privacy"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- **Local-only.** Everything runs in your dsh host process and browser; the only network traffic is "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"to the MCP servers *you already configured*.
- **No telemetry, no analytics, no external calls** — t"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"he panel never leaves your machine.
- The `/api/mcp-view/tools` route is served by the same-origin w"},{"id":"p37s4","text":"ebserver; it is **read-only** — it cannot call MCP tools, only list them.
- Last-used times come fro"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"m your own session logs on disk; nothing is sent anywhere.
- Passwords / credentials of your MCP ser"},{"id":"p37s6","text":"vers are **never** exposed — only transport type and endpoint URL."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## 🧩 Compatibility"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` (web profile) — same cadence as the ecosystem's pinned SDK version"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"s.
- Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the dsh runtime requirement — zstd session decoding is used).
- Br"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"owser: Chrome / Edge / Firefox (React 18, no build step for the client bundle)."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## ❓ FAQ"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"**Are MCP servers per-session or shared?**
Shared. MCP servers are configured once at the profile le"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"vel (`cordis.patch.yml`), connect once per process, and register their tools into the process-wide `"},{"id":"p41s3","text":"ToolRuntime` — every session and workspace sees the same set. A session whose agent preset restricts"},{"id":"p41s4","text":" tools may hide them *from the model*, but the registry stays global."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"**Where does «used …» come from?**
From `tool/call` events in your persisted session logs (`~/.dsh/s"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"essions`). It is the real dispatch timestamp of the last call of that tool. If the log has no calls "},{"id":"p42s3","text":"for a tool, the hint is simply absent."},{"id":"p43s1","text":"**Why are only some tools listed under "Other tools"?**
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
